protocol.reports: business-reports.json array, ChatGPT writes only; id,title,type,market,origin (radar|manual),status (research|needs_validation|ready_for_review|approved|rejected|launch_ready),recommendation (approve|revise|reject),approved boolean,summary,agents object keyed 1..27; each report status (complete|research),summary,findings,uncertainty,nextSteps,sources array {title,url}; processedRequestIds array per project. Only set approved true after explicit approve event and recommendation approve. Preapproval agents 1–9,26,27; others locked. No automatic spending, posting, contacting or buying. Preserve proposals array on each project (see proposal protocol). Optional productSummary: concise sourcing/price/margin hypothesis for physical products. Each opportunity (product, service or software) should include imageUrl (direct public HTTPS image), imageSource (original public page URL), imageCaption (Spanish, identify as third-party reference/competitor when appropriate). Use specific relevant images from verified public sources; never imply a reference is our product, customer or work. If no suitable image is available leave fields blank, add later; preserve previous verified images. Every project includes potential object per potential schema; app sums factors, orders by score, displays evidence confidence. Preserve existing scores unless meaningful new evidence.
protocol.requests: business-requests.json array, device appends {id,action:submit|approve|revise|reject|proposal,projectId,title,type,market,description,createdAt}. ChatGPT never overwrites requests; deduplicate using processedRequestIds. Preserve existing reports and IDs. Submit uses projectId. Radar IDs unique stable. Keep source links and distinction facts vs hypotheses.

proposals.request: action=proposal; projectId existing; title=recipient/company or customer segment; type=ES or EN; description=custom instructions. Deduplicate by processedRequestIds. Add a distinct proposal per request id; update existing generic proposal id=general when appropriate. Preserve other proposals.

schema.title: client-facing title
schema.subtitle: short value proposition
schema.benefits: concrete buyer benefits, conditional where unverified
schema.pricing: proposed price, terms, no fake discounts
schema.impact: transparent illustrative ROI, assumptions, no guarantees
schema.sources: public evidence links only; no internal costs or margins

proposals.rules: Before approval, proposal is an exploratory validation draft, not authorized commercial marketing or an offer; use conditional benefits and pilot/feedback invitation. After approval make a client-facing sales document, with verified features, scope, and caveats. No automatic sending. Never disclose internal strategy, profitability, private details, or claim confirmed customer problems without evidence. Provide a general proposal for researched projects and custom proposals on demand, in requested language; default EN for US, ES otherwise. Keep concise.

schema.reason: Spanish concise rationale with evidence and uncertainty

potential.rules: For every project calculate the sum of the six integer factors, same rubric for all categories. Score is an estimated opportunity attractiveness, not probability of success. Unknowns lower points; confidence low for preliminary research, medium only with credible supporting evidence, high only with validated customers, realistic costs and execution evidence. Demand: proven purchase intent, not views; profit: contribution after all variable costs and CAC; differentiation: defensibility vs competitors; execution: low capital, sourcing, delivery, skills; growth: acquisition channels, repeat/scale; risk: safety, legality, intellectual property, returns and dependencies. Re-evaluate on meaningful evidence, preserve existing score unless evidence or rubric changes, never inflate for novelty. Ranking descending across all categories; rejected last, missing unscored. Score is not approval. Save potential object, not just a numeric score.
